name: Sierra Leone
regionLevel: first-level division (ISO 3166-2), as in the N-Ways regions table

existing.system: No postcode. UPU format (2002 sheet): name, house number + street, locality, FREETOWN, SIERRA LEONE (e.g. '7A Ross Road, Cline, FREETOWN'). Street names and house numbers exist in central Freetown and larger towns; elsewhere people use landmarks, junctions and community names.
existing.status: None in practical use. No national digital address or postcode system was found as of 2026-10-17: the UPU sheet and Wikipedia's postcode list say Sierra Leone has no postal codes; the Ministry of Communications, NCRA (civil registration/ID) and MoICE sites mention no addressing system. The 2026 Population and Housing Census (countdown began 13 Oct 2026) and the October 2026 redistricting may produce new locality data later.
existing.openData: None found. OpenStreetMap is the main open source for street names (ODbL); house-number coverage was not counted (Overpass unreachable at the time of the count).
existing.recommendation: Use coordinates plus Plus Codes (Open Location Code, Apache-2.0) as the shareable code, OSM street/community names, and landmark descriptions. Re-check yearly for a national addressing launch.

sources.note: UPU addressing sheet, Sierra Leone, 07/2002: example '7A Ross Road Cline, FREETOWN'; contact Sierra Leone Postal Services Ltd, GPO, Siaka Stevens Street
NCRA site (2026-10-17): ID cards, NIN, data sharing with SLRSA; no addressing

sources.buildings: OpenStreetMap (ODbL); Google Open Buildings (CC BY 4.0) and Microsoft building footprints (ODbL) via Overture Maps
